title: 赛娜 · 晨光里的种子
description: 白发赛娜蹲在小花圃边撒种，巨大圣枪安静支在木架上。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Senna is an adult dark-skinned woman with very long pale hair, softly glowing green eyes, and an iconic flowing black-and-ivory coat. Her outfit is fully covering with boots and gloves; the immense rectangular relic cannon rests on a separate sturdy wooden support, not aimed.
art_direction.scene: She kneels beside a small raised garden bed and lets a few seeds fall from her gloved palm. A mint-colored lantern sits on the path, while the resting cannon remains a recognizable background silhouette and no magical discharge appears. Keep the composition spacious and peaceful, with visible wax-crayon strokes, warm paper margins, and every important prop clearly separated.
art_direction.palette: ivory, charcoal, pale mint, soil brown, warm gold
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
